one_sentence: Make the site read like a field notebook that keeps changing, not a portfolio index.
mechanism: Entries reorder by observation date; each material sample shows its latest reading.
signature_element: An expandable 'reading for that day' attached to every sample.
tradeoff: No conventional navigation; the first visit needs one sentence of guidance.
risk: With fewer than six entries the page may feel empty.
intent_fit: audience: non-specialists can still read one entry
not_this: Not a dark page with fluorescent green 'tech' styling.
